{{Quote|AGR's Harvest Festival was a time we cherished and celebrated.|[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref>}}
'''Harvest Festival''' was an annual, week-long event, consisting of contests and parties celebrated after the harvest. It was thrown by the [[Allied Grain and Roughage]] [[agro-combine]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
